_comment: Shared looks (PLAN.md §3): a shot's look is appended to every keyframe prompt of that shot, so shots of one side and era share film stock, colour and lens.
us-1957: Shot on 35mm colour motion picture film in 1957: a warm Kodachrome palette with rich reds and deep browns, soft natural film grain, gentle halation around bright lights, warm tungsten interior light. Period-accurate late-1950s clothing, hair, furniture and props. Cinematic composition, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, a still frame from a feature film.
ussr-1955: Shot on 35mm film in the mid-1950s Soviet Union: a cool, slightly desaturated palette with muted greens and steel greys, visible film grain, hard light from tall windows, the look of a Soviet feature film of the period. Period-accurate mid-1950s clothing, office furniture and machines. Cinematic composition, photorealistic, a still frame from a feature film.
orbit: Photorealistic, as if filmed by a camera in Earth orbit: pure black space, hard unfiltered sunlight with deep shadows, the thin glowing blue line of the atmosphere along the Earth's limb, clouds and oceans in fine detail, no stars visible. Cinematic, sharp, a still frame from a feature film.
